work_items.title: Solariun lens strip becomes real routed navigation with truthful per-lens state
work_items.source_state: SolariunPage renders a decorative <span> strip (projects/knowledge/memory/weaver) that never navigates; content ignores `section`; /solariun/bogus silently renders the projects view; App.tsx passes no onNavigate to SolariunPage.
work_items.target_behavior: Lenses render via shared SurfaceLenses, navigate to /solariun/<id> through the shared router with aria-current, content switches per lens (projects = real /solspire/projects read; knowledge/weaver = honest pointer to the canonical owning surface; memory = honest not-wired state; unknown section = honest not-a-lens state listing reconciled lenses).
out_of_scope: other surface pages owned by open PRs
work_items.verification_commands: cd web/arkadia_console && pnpm run build; python3 -m pytest tests/test_solariun_lens_contract.py + six console contract suites

work_items.title: Sign-in returns the user to the destination it interrupted
work_items.source_state: Threshold and shell sign-in dropped the intended destination; after signIn resolved the user stayed on /login with no route back to the requested protected surface.
work_items.target_behavior: Crossing to login records route.path via one shared wrapper; a confirmed sign-in consumes it (session memory, then ?returnTo=), validated through resolvePath so external/invented targets degrade to the router fallback and /login targets are refused; failure path navigates nothing and spends nothing.

work_items.source_state: SolariunPage advertised runtime-context as NotYetWired with a wrong /api prefix while the backend serves GET /solspire/projects/{project_id}/runtime-context (owner-scoped).
work_items.target_behavior: Per-project Runtime toggle opens a read-only canvas: registry-derived percent-encoded path builder, actual binding states with UNKNOWN never upgraded, epistemic_boundary shown, ambiguous 404 stated not guessed, store records as bounded counts.

work_items.title: Solariun legacy inbound aliases (/codex, /loops, /dashboard, /settings, /account, /personal-echofeild, /echofeild-matrix)
work_items.blocker: lib/router.ts PATH_ALIASES is owned by open PR #505 (/home, /knowledge-os, /gate, /living-gate); the archived mappings are section-bearing (e.g. /codex -> solariun/knowledge) and PATH_ALIASES maps path->surface only, so a correct recovery needs a section-aware alias structure — a structural change to the same file another draft PR is actively editing. Coordinate after #505 lands.
